scores.scale: 0 = unusable; 5 = workable with substantial friction; 10 = exceptionally clear, responsive and satisfying in the assessed scope. Subjective holistic judgments, not calculated from win/loss or a desired target. Unseen content contributes no assumed enjoyment.

reasons.overall_mobile: Strong visual identity and useful guidance, but observed movement/interaction/combat friction dominated these short portrait attempts. A successful receiver recovery showed learnability. Losses themselves are not the grade.
reasons.controls: Opening tap aim and FIRE worked and native two-contact input supported movement plus firing. Precision around cover and receiver range was difficult; attempted tap aims often lacked evident acceptance. Dash was tried but its effectiveness remained unclear.
reasons.gameplay: Opening optic combat and first memory recovery supplied clear short-term achievements. Patrol pressure repeatedly interrupted navigation and receiver learning; I did not reach enough content to judge progression depth or sustained enjoyment.
reasons.presentation: Cohesive teal/amber atmosphere, striking title, distinctive receiver/weapon models, and polished terminal/recovery feedback. Audio and hardware smoothness unassessed.
reasons.usability: In-game handbook, paused route map, contextual action prompts and straightforward fresh restart are helpful. Nearby range feedback did not resolve my obstruction/routing confusion quickly enough under attack.
reasons.readability: Health, ammunition, primary objectives, recovery and end stats were clear at 390x844. Small secondary labels and scene obstruction were harder to parse; inspection pauses aided this assessment.

cleanup.interpretation: Exact owned driver and Chrome PIDs absent; no kill commands used.

helpful.detail: Visible instruction to tap enemy then hold FIRE enabled an immediate successful opening kill; shorter burst preserved ammunition on attempt 2.
Readable objective selection, player marker, receiver circles, route line and remaining walking distance made location recoverable; map stayed open until visibly closed.
NEARBY objective, path arrows, named environment signage and contextual VAULT/CLEAR LANDING made progress legible.
MEMORY RECOVERED, filled 01 marker, next objective and replenished supplies provided clear success feedback.
Actual results, accuracy, critical kills, tap aims and START FRESH were visible and readable.

frustrating.detail: Long movement holds overshot the route to the north wall; walls and cover consumed much of the portrait view.
NEARBY and 3.3m CLOSER did not tell me how to get around the obstruction; repeated USE and lateral attempts failed under incoming fire before repositioning worked.
Simultaneously finding routes, aiming and using crowded lower-right controls was demanding. I took substantial damage without consistently locating its source.
Large dark overhangs/walls obscured the scene; tiny compass, threat text and some world labels required inspection pauses.
